about: Attention family per architecture, and the KV-cache byte layouts sizing uses. An architecture not listed is gqa. replicated_across_tp: every tensor-parallel rank holds the whole KV cache, so only decode context parallelism (DCP) shards it. dcp_flags: flags every plan with DCP > 1 passes for that family; a runtime that cannot take them gets no DCP.

dcp_flags.evidence: with DCP > 1, vLLM 0.30.0+amzn2023 in AWS's SageMaker image (server-sagemaker-cuda-v2.6.1) picks the a2a backend, and the FlashMLA sparse kernel raises NotImplementedError at startup; ag_rs served on 8xH200 with DCP 8, 2026-10-09
